description: Requests a person gives an LLM agent, each with the one operation that answers it. Every operation reads, so a read-only agent grant reaches it.

Which tenants are there?

Show the system settings.
How many sessions have there been, and how long do they last?
List the configurations used to bootstrap interest rate curves.
